gloss: red ink pad, vermilion seal pad

definitions.gloss: red ink pad, vermilion seal pad
definitions.explanation: A pad containing red or vermilion ink used for stamping personal seals (hanko) in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{朱肉|しゅにく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: I press the seal onto the red ink pad and stamp it.

examples.japanese: {朱肉|しゅにく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}く→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The red ink pad has faded.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{朱肉|しゅにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}わない→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いけない→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: I need to buy a new red ink pad.

notes:
USAGE: {朱肉|しゅにく} is an essential item for using ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧/⟦{判子|はんこ}→判子：00089_hanko⟧ (personal seals), which are widely used in Japan for signing documents.

TYPES:
- ⟦{練|ね}り→練る：09751_neru⟧{朱肉|しゅにく} - paste-type ink pad (traditional, higher quality)
- ⟦スポンジ→スポンジ：04505_suponji⟧{朱肉|しゅにく} - sponge-type ink pad (common for everyday use)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {朱肉|しゅにく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to apply red ink)
- {朱肉|しゅにく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{押|お}しつける→押し付ける：04236_oshitsukeru⟧ (to press onto the ink pad)

CULTURAL NOTE: While digital signatures are becoming more common, {朱肉|しゅにく} and ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧ remain important in Japanese business and legal contexts.

NOTE: The color is traditionally vermilion (⟦{朱|しゅ}→朱：24206_shu⟧), a red-orange shade considered auspicious in East Asian cultures.
